name: 颜色配置文件元数据
description: 分析 ICC color profile data, 色彩空间 declarations, bit depth, and rendering intent 元数据 以检测 AI generation 模式. Professional cameras embed complex color profiles, while AI tools typically output basic sRGB.
algorithm: ICC/色彩空间元数据分析器
mechanism:
The color profile 分析 examines multiple 元数据 layers:

1. **ICC Profile Detection**: 识别 the embedded ICC color profile type. Professional cameras use Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, or Display P3 profiles, while AI生成的 images almost universally use basic sRGB IEC61966-2.1.

2. **Bit Depth Analysis**: 检查 color depth 元数据. RAW files from cameras use 12-bit, 14-bit, or 16-bit color depth. AI outputs are invariably 8-bit per channel.

3. **Color Space Consistency**: Cross-validates 色彩空间 declarations 跨 EXIF, ICC, and XMP 元数据. Inconsistencies suggest 元数据 fabrication.

4. **Rendering Intent Check**: Professional workflows preserve rendering intent (perceptual, relative colorimetric). AI tools rarely set this 元数据 correctly.
parameters:
Camera profiles: Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, Display P3, DCI-P3
AI-typical: sRGB IEC61966-2.1
Bit depths: 8-bit (standard/AI), 12/14/16-bit (professional RAW)
Rendering intents: perceptual, relative colorimetric, 饱和度, absolute colorimetric
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80%. Strong indicator when advanced color profiles (Adobe RGB, ProPhoto) are present. Less reliable for consumer cameras that default to sRGB.
useCase: Supporting evidence in 元数据分析 pipeline. Particularly useful for identifying professional photography (其 uses wide-gamut profiles) vs AI生成的 content (其 uses sRGB). Effective as part of a multi-signal approach.
strengths:
• 专业颜色配置文件非常难以被AI工具复制
• 位深度分析可明确区分相机与AI
• 低误报率
• 快速、无损分析
• 有助于识别RAW来源的图像
limitations:
• 许多消费级相机也默认使用sRGB
• AI工具理论上可以嵌入自定义ICC配置文件
• JPEG转换会丢失配置文件信息
• 社交媒体平台经常删除ICC配置文件
• 无法区分sRGB相机和AI输出
